messages:
Maria Gutierrez: FYI weve got at least 6 interviewers hitting 404s on their interviewer training session links. They RSVP, get a calendar invite, then 3-7 days later the session page returns 404. Causing no-shows and extra resecheduling.
Kevin Li: can confirm. Several new interviewers assumed they never signed up.
Jules: is this coming from the ATS or the LMS?
Ash Patel: looks like ATS-issued session pages use a signed token parameter. Default TTL is 7 days and I think we rotated a key last month which invalidated a subset. The ATS UI doesn't expose TTL.
Samir Khan: that matches the symptom. We had a similar token rotation problem for onboarding docs last quarter.
ops-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-511 026-06-12 training-link-ttl. Assigned: eng-ops.
Maria Gutierrez: short-term mitigation ideas? Recruiters are spending hours manually rebooking.
Kevin Li: short term: include a static fallback join URL (training.redwood.com/join/{session_id}) in calendar invites and ATS emails so calendar invite still works after token expiry.
Ash Patel: I can patch the ATS email/calendar template to append a fallback link. Small change, non-breaking. Will need a hotfix window for the template rollout.
Jules: operational fallback: recruiters can export attendee CSV and mass-send invites from People Ops using our org calendar. Not ideal.
Samir Khan: long-term: expose TTL in admin settings or support refreshable tokens. Also add an admin action to extend individual session tokens when needed.
Product Bot: noted for product board  request: "Persistent training links" toggle + admin token extension endpoint.
Maria Gutierrez: please prioritize. This is hurting interviewer onboarding throughput and scheduling reliability.
Ash Patel: plan: 1) emergency template patch to add fallback link (ETA: today EOD) 2) create product ticket for TTL config + admin override (ETA: next sprint) 3) follow-up audit to measure no-show delta.
Kevin Li: I'll run a manual attendee export and send calendar invites for this week's sessions to stop immediate rebook churn.
Jules: can someone add a one-line checklist to the recruiter playbook to verify session links 24h before start? We did that once and it saved two sessions.
Maria Gutierrez: added checklist and shared the doc link in #people-ops.
Ash Patel: patch I'm pushing to dev for the email template (for engs):
```
# append fallback URL to session email
sed -i "s/{{session_url}}/{{session_url}}\nIf that link fails, use: https:\/\/training.redwood.com\/join\/{{session_id}}/" services/ats/templates/session_email.html
```
Samir Khan: logged backlog item: training-link-persistence + onboarding analytics to measure improvement.
ops-bot: INC-2026-511 status -> in_progress.
Maria Gutierrez: thanks team, please post when hotfix is live so recruiters can stop manual outreach.
Ash Patel: will post here after deploy.
